name: 正常流程：模板匹配节点 - 模型匹配模式完整配置
description: 验证模板匹配节点在「模型匹配」模式下的完整配置流程，包括模型选择、数据来源、应用环节、应用场景等字段，验证模型匹配与规则匹配的字段差异。

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')]; for (const item of items) { const label = item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label label')?.textContent || ''; if (label.includes('匹配模式')) { const sel = item.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { const r = sel.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: Math.round(r.x + r.width / 2), y: Math.round(r.y + r.height / 2) }; } } } return null; })()
((pos) => pos && pos.x ? { ok: true, action: 'mouse_click', x: pos.x, y: pos.y } : { ok: false })

(() => { const dds = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dds) { const items = [...dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')]; for (const item of items) { if (item.textContent.trim() === '模型匹配') { const r = item.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: Math.round(r.x + r.width / 2), y: Math.round(r.y + r.height / 2), text: '模型匹配' }; } } } return null; })()
((pos) => pos && pos.x ? { ok: true, action: 'mouse_click', x: pos.x, y: pos.y } : { ok: false })
